title: Kissed Indulgent Uruguayan Cheese Casserole
description: A cultured and pillowy Uruguayan dish featuring sesame seed oil and cure, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly casserole is perfect for special occasions. It combines the richness of cheese with the depth of sesame seed oil.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame seed oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, grated cheese, dried cure, and cooked onion mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, beaten eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the wet ingredients over the pasta mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
